messages:
alex: Quick heads-up: flash-attention upstream merged v2.3 with a change to the kernel heuristic. Running paged-attn on A100s I see a reproducible latency bump for our common shapes (seq=1024, batch=4). Repro + numbers below.

lia: Where did you run this? staging or prod?

alex: Staging canaries. Small perf job across 6 ded nodes. Summary:
- fa v2.2 + xformers pinned: p50=96ms p95=181ms (batch=4, seq=1024)
- fa v2.3: p50=103ms p95=198ms same config

mike: That delta is concerning. Could be kernel selection flipping to fallback. Did you profile?

alex: Yeah. Flame and sampling profiler show the fused path falling back more frequently. `flash_attn_fallback` samples increased ~30%. Looks shape-triggered: heads*head_dim == 2048 (e.g., 16x128).

eva: Do you have the upstream PR?

alex: PR: https://github.com/flash-attention/flash-attention/pull/942. They added a vec4-avoid heuristic for certain shapes that ends up excluding our previously-fast kernel.

lia: We use head_dim=128 a lot (LLama forks), so this explains it. Can we override selection in our runtime temporarily?

mike: We already have a runtime flag `--attn-kernel-preference=legacy|prefer_fa|auto`. For Dedicated workloads we can force `legacy`. Need to measure memory impact and peak occupancy.

alex: Quick experiment: forcing legacy on one ded node: p50=95ms p95=183ms (slightly better than v2.3), but memory usage up ~6% and SM occupancy changes. Not free.

infra-bot: Suggested canary plan: 10% ded capacity -> perf sweeps 12h -> rollback if p95 > baseline + 3%.

mike: I'll run a combinatorial matrix: FA v2.2/v2.3 xFormers v0.8.x/v0.9.x vLLM pinned/HEAD across seq=[512,1024,2048] and heads/head_dim combos. ETA ~6h. Posting CSVs back here.

lia: Note: xFormers wheel we picked up yesterday changed an nvrtc flag that can affect FMA/MAD choice; vendor driver notes in #vendors mentioned a metal patch too. Could be multi-factor.

alex: Repro command used (staging):
```
./run_perf.sh --model llama-13b --batch 4 --seq 1024 --attn=paged --kv-cache=on --flash-attn=system
```
Profiler samples (top rows):
```
flash_attn_fallback  33.9%
flash_attn_vec4     13.1%
kv_cache_lookup      8.0%
softmax_kernel       6.5%
```

ev an-sre: If paged-attn interacts with KV prefetching we should watch for page faults under heavy concurrency. Ping me if you see OOMs or major pageins.

mike: Early partial datapoint: regressions only manifest when heads*head_dim == 2048 shapes (16x128). Other shapes show negligible change. Uploading CSV to /perf/attn/1860077777_matrix.csv now.

alex: If it's deterministic on that product we can add a small special-case in kernel-selection to prefer legacy for that shape until upstream adjusts heuristics. Cheap and low-risk.

lia: I'll open an upstream issue referencing the PR and our numbers, include the minimal repro and perf CSV.

alex: I'll also draft a 1-file runtime change to expose per-model `attn_kernel` config in Consul and a canary rollout plan. ETA PR ~2h.

deploy-bot: Created ticket RN-3912 "attn kernel override + canary plan" assigned to alex, mike, infra (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RN-3912).

eva: Action list:
- mike: finish matrix + upload CSV (ETA 6h)
- alex: measure memory impact for forcing legacy on ded nodes (ETA 2h)
- lia: open upstream issue with FA authors + repro (ETA now)
- infra-bot: schedule canary if matrix confirms regressions

mike: Starting jobs now. Will post incremental results. If we need a hotfix, a selection override per-model seems quickest.

alex: Agreed. Keep this thread tight. If anyone spots page-faults or KV-cache sizing regressions, tag @evan-sre and @infra immediately.

mike: Partial CSV uploaded: /perf/attn/1860077777_matrix_partial.csv. Early takeaway: shape-dependent heuristic flip is the root cause.

lia: Thanks. If upstream moves fast we can revert our override; otherwise we'll land the per-model flag and roll out to affected customers only.

eva: Looping research tomorrow to evaluate vec4 vs quantization tradeoffs. Good triage so far. :thumbsup:
